title: Show HN: SolidCraft – Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust (With MCP Support)
summary: SolidCraft 是一个用 Rust 开发的开源参数化 CAD 工具，支持 MCP（模型上下文协议），看点在于将编程式建模与 AI 辅助集成，为开发者提供可扩展的轻量级设计替代方案。

title: Muse Wonder

title: Gemini 4 Argon
summary: 谷歌发布Gemini 4 Argon模型，主打性能与效率提升，并衍生出面向机器人领域的专用版本，看点在于其多模态能力与硬件集成潜力。

title: Show HN: Guitoro, a virtual guitar you strum with your keyboard
text:
Guitoro is a free browser guitar using recordings of real instruments. You can strum with your keyboard, mouse, or touchscreen, choose acoustic, classical, electric guitar or bass, and see chord fingering and each stroke. Song practice can be slowed to 20%, and there are free chord tools and tuners. No signup or download.

1 minute video demo: https://youtu.be/DtcluMLdSgs

I would love feedback on how the strumming feels and sounds.
summary: Guitoro是一款免费浏览器虚拟吉他，可用键盘、鼠标或触屏弹奏真实乐器录音，支持多种吉他类型、和弦指法显示及慢速练习功能。亮点是无需注册下载，且提供和弦工具和调音器，适合快速上手体验弹奏手感。

title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic

title: 11 year old unsoundness bugs found in Rust borrow checker
summary: 该帖子报告了Rust借用检查器中存在长达11年的内存安全漏洞，可能导致未定义行为，对Rust语言的安全性承诺构成重大挑战。
